crossRefs.note: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

translations.web: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
translations.bsb: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
translations.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
translations.asv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.
